description: Review personal or family health records (lab results, imaging, prescriptions, medication, symptom notes): compare every metric across the full history, draw time trends, report and track data conflicts, grade evidence, and highlight clinical risks. Generic layer — it contains no patient data. The project layer injects the profile and all paths. Triggers: health record, medical record, lab result, bloodtest, imaging, prescription, medication, symptom, trend, review, analysis, intake, index, registry, merge, rename, audit, 健康档案, 化验, 处方, 用药, 趋势, 复阅, 分析, 建档, 整理, 合并, 更名, 审计, 注册表. Never diagnose, never prescribe, never edit source data.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
